name: Brine rats

variantInfo.name: Brine rat
notes: Not aggressive; attacks with stab and can hit up to 9.
Always drops bones and raw rat meat.
Carries the rat attribute, so rat bone weapons deal boosted damage.

locationComparison.name: Brine Rat Cavern
notes: A spade is required to enter, by digging south of the windswept tree east of Olaf Hradson.
The entire cavern is a single combat zone; dwarf multicannons may be used.
Two safespots: the black bones to the south-east and the north-west corner.

taskNotes: Brine rats can be assigned by Vannaka, Chaeldar, Konar, and Nieve upon reaching 47 Slayer and 45 combat, with partial completion of Olaf's Quest.
Brine rats are found only in the Brine Rat Cavern, entered by digging with a spade south of the windswept tree east of Olaf Hradson.
Turael and Spria list Brine rats only as an alternative kill for their generic Rats task, not as a Brine rats assignment.
The cavern is a single combat zone with two safespots; a dwarf multicannon may be used.
Brine rats have the rat attribute, so rat bone weapons deal significantly boosted damage.
Bring food if you do not have high (~70) Defence; Bones to Peaches tablets or cooking dropped raw rat meat on Olaf's fire outside the cavern can sustain longer trips.
Brine rats drop the Brine sabre (1 in 512) and medium clue scrolls.
The slayerTargetId 243 is SYNTHETIC (WC-1..11 allocation contract, 240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
recommendedMethod: Melee with any decent weapon - rat bone weapons such as the Bone mace deal boosted damage against them. Cannon or safespot in the single-combat cavern for faster, safer kills.
